question.text: In brown ring Fe and NO exist as Fe<sup>+</sup> and NO<sup>+</sup> rather than Fe<sup>2</sup><sup>+</sup> and NO. These forms can be differentiated by

options.text: Measuring the conductivity of an aqueous solution of the complex
By careful crystallization of the complex under special conditions and measuring the magnetic moment in solid state
Determining elevation in boiling point using the complex as solute

solution.text: When the combination is Fe<sup>2</sup><sup>+</sup> and NO, there will be 5 unpaired electrons in the complex ( 4 in Fe<sup>2</sup><sup>+</sup> and 1 in NO) and when the combination is Fe<sup>+</sup> and NO<sup>+</sup>, there will be only 3 unpaired electrons which can be differentiated by measuring the magnetic moments.
